Name: Befuddled Bears
Overview:
The bears are befuddled! Help these batty bears blast their way through challenges in this puzzle, arcade-shooter.

Follow the bears' escapades in story mode, and play with - or against - three friends in local multi-player. Along the way, unlock a bunch of bears and weapons, each with unique strategies to master. Did we mention cookies would be involved?

The bears need you - don't let them down!
